theme-opening.hears: The theme alone, pp: a long Bb4, then the violins step A4-Bb4-C5-Bb4-Db5 ... up to Eb5 at 20.1 s; 11 slow notes, each ~0.8 s.
theme-opening.rule: the Bb4 0.93-8.64 s (piano model + audio), then the skyline of clean roll notes 8.6-21.1 s, >= 0.28 s

theme-answer.hears: The answer over a Gb bass: Bb4 held, C5-Db5-Bb4, then the line falls Ab4-Gb4-F4-Eb4 and climbs back in the middle voice C4-Db4-Eb4-F4-Gb4-Ab4-Bb4.
theme-answer.rule: skyline of clean roll notes 30.0-49.4 s at G3 and up, >= 0.28 s

theme-restated.hears: The theme again from its long Bb4 (53.5 s): A4-Bb4-C5 ... Db5-Eb5, a little louder; it ends on the Ab chord at 70.1 s.
theme-restated.rule: skyline of clean roll notes 53.4-70.1 s at G3 and up, >= 0.28 s

first-ascent.hears: Four long high notes as the music opens up: C5 (70.1), Gb5 held 7 s (71.0), Cb6 (82.9), Bb5 (85.2). Slow, rising, crescendo -24 to -20 dB.
first-ascent.rule: skyline of clean roll notes 70.0-86.1 s at G3 and up, >= 0.28 s

first-swell.hears: The first forte: the theme in the middle register, Eb4-F4-D4-Eb4 ... Ab4 (vel 98-103 at 93-98 s) up to Db5 at 98.7 s, then sinking to C5-Bb4.
first-swell.rule: skyline of clean roll notes 86.1-103.4 s at G3 and up, >= 0.28 s

second-strophe.hears: The second strophe from a long Bb4 (103.5 s): falling phrases Ab4-Bb4-Cb5-Bb4-Ab4-Gb4, then the line sinks into the middle register (F4 ... Db4) over a bass that walks down.
second-strophe.rule: skyline of clean roll notes 103.4-134.5 s at G3 and up, >= 0.28 s

second-build.hears: The second build: from A3/F3 the line climbs Db4-Eb4-F4 ... F5 (144.6, vel 94), Db5 (146.2, vel 98) to a held Eb5 (149.5 s, -9 dB), then D-natural (154.6, 156.3): a turn of colour, and it ebbs.
second-build.rule: skyline of clean roll notes 134.5-162.7 s at G3 and up, >= 0.28 s

violins-descent.hears: The violins step down Gb5-F5-Eb5-Db5-Cb5 (162.9-166 s), then wind around Bb4/Cb5/Ab4 (168-188 s) over the lower strings' surge at 180 s; a quiet Bb-major glimpse at 192.6 s.
violins-descent.rule: skyline of clean roll notes 162.7-199.5 s at G3 and up, >= 0.28 s

low-strophe.hears: The darkest stretch: the line in the low middle register (Bb3-Ab4), long notes far apart (F4 held 199.6, Eb4 209.8, Gb4 220.4 held 7 s), the cellos' rising cell C3-Eb3-F3-Gb3 at 232-235 s, the violas rocking F3-Bb3 at 252 s.
low-strophe.rule: skyline of clean roll notes 199.5-257.4 s at C3 and up, >= 0.28 s, keeping voices that move under the held Gb chord (no far-below rule)

third-build.hears: The third build starts low and loud: Eb4-Db4-Eb4-C4 (vel 88-96) then Eb4-Gb4; from 267 s the strings swell (peak -13.6 dB at 268) with no transcribed note.
third-build.rule: skyline of clean roll notes 257.4-275.1 s at G3 and up, >= 0.28 s (the transcription is empty 267-275)

waves.hears: Rising waves in the violins: Eb5-F5-D5 ... Eb5 (vel 104 at 278.8), then Gb5-Eb5-F5-Gb5-F5-Gb5-Eb5-Ab5-F5 (280-286 s, -15 dB), a Db chord, and the plateau (Bb4 held from 291.9 s).
waves.rule: skyline of clean roll notes 275.1-303.3 s at G3 and up, >= 0.28 s

stretto-cells.hears: The voices enter one after another with the same cell, hammered: violas Db4-Eb4-F4-Db4-Eb4 (304-307 s, vel 70-102), cellos F4-Eb4-F4 (307.5-309), violas Gb4-F4, cellos Gb4-Ab4 (vel 114 at 314.2). 16 strokes ~0.75 s apart.
stretto-cells.rule: clean roll notes 303.9-315.0 s lasting 0.28-1.2 s (the moving cells under the held F5 and Ab5)

ascent-to-top.hears: The violins strain upward, ff: C6 (315.1), F6, Db6, Eb6, F6, Gb6 (328.2 s), vel 100-116, the last stretch the tracks hear.
ascent-to-top.rule: skyline of clean roll notes 315.0-329.3 s at Db5 and up (the top voice; the C5/F4 under the F6s are inner voices), >= 0.28 s

climax-line.hears: The fff climax after its first chord (Eb6 at 328.79, the last note of ascent-to-top); the tracks hear nothing here. Five new chords with the violins on top: Gb6 (330.2), then Bb6 re-struck as the harmony turns beneath (332.8, 333.8, 336.9, 342.7), the last held through a swell to the breath at 345.5 s.
climax-line.rule: AUDIO.climaxStrokes: the climax's chord changes 330.23-342.67 s (an onset peak or piano-model attack on a change in the chroma), pitch from the piano model (<= Bb6) or the top CQT bin

climax-chord.hears: The one fff blow of the piece: after a split-second breath the whole orchestra lands on the high chord (346.2 s, -1.2 dB, the loudest moment) and holds it until it is cut off dead at 353.0 s.
climax-chord.rule: AUDIO.climaxChord: Ab5 + Ab6 from 346.21 s (the onset after the breath) to the cut-off at 353.0 s

hymn-chords.hears: After the silence, soft chords like a hymn, pp, each held 2-6 s: 356.5 (Cb), 358.4 (Fb), 363.0 (A over C#), 364.9 (D), 369.1 (B minor), 371.0 (C), 374.0 (F). The bass sinks E2-C#2-D2-B2-C2-F2.
hymn-chords.rule: every clean roll note 356.4-376.5 s (5 chords) plus the two chords the tracks miss (AUDIO.hymnA 363.0, AUDIO.hymnD 364.85)

reprise-theme.hears: The theme comes back from its long Bb4 (382.3 s), doubled an octave lower: A4-Bb4-C5-Bb4-C5-Db5 ... Eb5, landing on a C5 held 7.7 s (396.1 s).
reprise-theme.rule: skyline of clean roll notes 380.6-403.4 s at G3 and up, >= 0.28 s

reprise-answer.hears: The answering phrase, in octaves: Bb4 held, then Db5-C5-Bb4-C5-Db5-Eb5-F5-Gb5 (412.9 s, its top) and all the way down F5-Eb5-Db5-C5-Bb4-Ab4-Gb4-Bb4-Ab4-F4-Gb4 to F4 (422.6 s).
reprise-answer.rule: skyline of clean roll notes 403.4-426.0 s at G3 and up, >= 0.28 s

coda-cell.hears: The head of the theme one last time, spent: Bb4 (426.0), Bb4-A4-Bb4-C5, A4 held 5.7 s; then very low and soft (vel 17-65) Bb3-A3-Bb3-C4 (438.4-447 s).
coda-cell.rule: the piano model's Bb4 at 426.0 (merged, held to 429.06), then the skyline of clean roll notes 429.0-448.5 s, >= 0.28 s

last-chords.hears: The two last chords: F major over C (448.5 s), then F major over F (455.4 s), unresolved (the piece is in Bb minor), fading to nothing by 465.4 s.
last-chords.rule: clean roll notes 448.5-452 s (the F/A of the penultimate chord, its fragments merged) with its bass C3 (AUDIO.penultBass), then the last chord (AUDIO.lastChord)

melody.hears: The line one follows from the first Bb to the coda: the theme, its answers, the waves and the climax top. The always-on lead thread.
melody.rule: union of the phrase sets theme-opening, theme-answer, theme-restated, first-ascent, first-swell, second-strophe, second-build, violins-descent, low-strophe, third-build, waves, ascent-to-top, climax-line, reprise-theme, reprise-answer, coda-cell (stretto-cells, climax-chord, hymn-chords and last-chords are separate)

bass-line.hears: The slow bass: one long note every few seconds, walking down by steps (F#2-F2-Eb2-Db2 ...; Ab1 at 86.2 s, B1 at 108.8 s), in the tenor (F3-Bb3) through the low strophe and the build, silent from 292 s to the hymn (the transcription hears no low voice in the climb and the climax), sinking again in the hymn. A pulse of tolls, never busy.
bass-line.rule: the lowest clean roll note of each cluster below MIDI 50 lasting >= 0.5 s (183-330 s: up to F#3, lasting >= 1 s); plus the audio basses (3.95 Bb2, hymn C#2/D2, 448.52 C3, 455.4 F2)

deep-tolls.hears: The deepest notes, the bass's rare tolls under the first swell and the second strophe: Ab1 (86.2, 87.5), C#2 (98.5), B1 (108.8, 109.6), C#2 (120.5).
deep-tolls.rule: clean roll notes at or below MIDI 37 (C#2), lasting >= 0.5 s

violin-line.hears: The violin track's top line (YourMT3+ label): most of the theme, the waves and the ascent. Silent in the climax (the tracks hear nothing 329-356 s).
violin-line.rule: skyline of the violin track (clean), >= 0.28 s

viola-line.hears: The viola track's top line (YourMT3+ label): an inner voice, sparse; it carries the stretto cell at 304-307 and 312 s and rocks F3-Bb3 at 252 s.
viola-line.rule: skyline of the viola track (clean), >= 0.28 s

cello-line.hears: The cello track's top line (YourMT3+ label): mostly the bass, but it sings the rising cell C3-Eb3-F3-Gb3 (232-235 s) and the stretto F4-Eb4-F4 ... Ab4 (307-314 s, vel 90-114).
cello-line.rule: skyline of the cello track (clean), >= 0.28 s

theme-heads.hears: Seven long notes, each the first note of a statement of the theme (the held Bb before it moves): the recurring event of the piece, 4-8 s each, the last one an octave low (Bb3 at 438.4 s).
theme-heads.rule: the long note that opens each statement of the theme: Bb4 0.93, Bb4 30.02, Bb4 53.48, Bb4 103.53, Bb4 382.28, Bb4 426, Bb3 438.4 (clean roll / piano model)

cadence-chords.hears: The held chords where a phrase comes to rest (Ab at 21.1, F at 49.5, Ab at 70.1 ... the F chords of the end): one soft block each, 3-8 s long.
cadence-chords.rule: clean roll clusters with >= 3 notes of which >= 3 last >= 2.5 s, whole chord, outside the hymn (356-377 s); plus the last chord (AUDIO.lastChord)

long-tones.hears: Only the long held notes of the line (3-8 s): the theme's Bbs, Gb5 at 71, the plateau Bb4, C5 at 396 ... For handover-type widgets that need long, slow notes.
long-tones.rule: melody notes lasting >= 3.0 s, plus the climax chord's top and the last chord's top

octave-doublings.hears: The theme doubled at the octave: the climb (315-329 s, C6/C5 ... Eb6/Eb5) and above all the reprise (384-421 s), where every melody note has its twin an octave down.
octave-doublings.rule: clean roll clusters (notes >= 0.28 s) whose two highest pitches are an octave apart: both notes, 300-430 s

ff-blows.hears: The strongest strokes of the ascent (vel 109-116, at most one per 0.6 s, up to the first chord of the climax at 328.79), the five chord changes of the climax (330.2-342.7) and the fff arrival at 346.2 s. The only place in the piece for fireworks.
ff-blows.rule: clean roll notes 314-329.3 s with velocity >= 109, one per 0.6 s (the highest of an attack); the climax chord changes (AUDIO.climaxStrokes); the climax chord (346.21)

forte-accents.hears: The loudest attacks of the swells before the climax: Eb4/F4/Ab4 at 93-98 s, F5/Db5/F4 at 144-147 s, Db4 at 258 s, Eb5/C5 at 278.8-279.1 s, the waves at 281-285 s, the stretto at 304-313 s. Points of pressure, a few per swell.
forte-accents.rule: clean roll notes 85-314 s with velocity >= 95 and >= 0.28 s, the top of each attack

audio-fills.hears: Only what the transcription misses and the audio shows: the lower strings' entrance (3.95), the climax's chord turn (336.9), the fff arrival (346.21), two hymn chords (363.0, 364.85), the bass C3 (448.5) and the last chord (455.4).
